name: application-work-order-card
title: Work Order Card
description: Maintenance/manufacturing work order with part, quantity, due date, and a segmented stage-progress bar, plus a compact list-row variant for scanning many orders at once.
useWhen: Tracking a maintenance or manufacturing work order through discrete production stages.
Showing the part, quantity, and due date needed to fulfill an order at a glance.
Listing many open work orders compactly for a dispatcher or supervisor view.
avoidWhen: The item being tracked is a dated goal or deliverable rather than a production/maintenance order — use application-milestone-card instead.
Progress is best expressed as a single percentage rather than discrete named stages.
You need per-station real-time status across a whole line — use a station/line status grid instead.
responsiveBehavior: Variant 1 has a fixed max width sized for a detail card; the stage bar segments scale to fill the available width. Variant 2's list rows truncate long titles and keep the due-date/stage summary right-aligned.
accessibility: The status badge in Variant 1 pairs a color tint with a text label, not color alone.
Each stage segment has a visually-hidden label stating its name and status (complete/current/pending) for screen reader users.
Variant 2's status dot is decorative; the order title and stage summary carry the actual status information in text.

variants.title: Detail card
variants.description: Work order detail card with part, quantity, due date, assignee, and a segmented stage-progress bar.
accessibility: Each stage segment carries a visually-hidden name and status label.

variants.title: Detail card (Dark)
variants.description: Work order detail card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Stage segment contrast (blue vs. gray-700) meets WCAG AA on the dark card background.

variants.title: Compact list
variants.description: Compact list-row variant for scanning many open work orders at once.
accessibility: Status is conveyed in text (stage summary) alongside the decorative color dot, not by color alone.

variants.title: Compact list (Dark)
variants.description: Compact work-order list row adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and dot colors meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark row background.
